trust_decision.summary: Whether a zonemd-check auth zone below (not at) a trust anchor may be served while its ZONEMD/DNSSEC verification is still pending; decided in auth_zones_lookup and auth_zones_downstream_answer by the zonemd_callback_env pending marker. At the pinned commit this gate is ALREADY present (the CVE-2026-77955 fix is in the pinned tree).

landing_point.why: The 'else if(anchor)' branch of auth_zone_verify_zonemd is where a zone below a trust anchor starts the async DNSKEY lookup and returns, opening the window the summary describes.

fix_sites.entry_point: DNS query -> validator (validator/val_sigcrypt.c dnskeyset_verify_rrset); NOT the CVE-2026-77955 property, the supplied diff fixes CVE-2026-85501 (DNSSEC work limits)
DNS query -> validator DS/DNSKEY chain (validator/val_utils.c), same mismatch
auth-zone zonemd-check load/transfer (services/authzone.c), signature-only plumbing change
upstream response scrubbing (iterator/iter_scrub.c), DS rrset truncation
cache answer (daemon/worker.c, services/cache/dns.c, services/mesh.c) secure-status check

O3_reason_to_dismiss: RPZ is a separate feature (response policy, not answer serving), so a solver could argue that the zone content an RPZ zone applies before ZONEMD verification completes is outside the 'serve auth zone' scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: fallback-enabled zones must still fall back to recursion (not SERVFAIL) while verification is pending; zones not under a trust anchor or at a trust anchor must not be blocked

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RPZ policy data inserted from a zonemd-check auth zone during transfer is applied without consulting the ZONEMD pending marker
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: RPZ is a neighbouring feature; the advisory talks about serving zone data
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: services/rpz.c, same package, no zonemd reference in rpz.c

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third zone-content consumer (e.g. a NOTIFY/serial probe answer or a libunbound path) that checks zone_expired but not the pending marker
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the pending gate was added beside the zone_expired test at exactly two call sites, so a maintainer adding a new consumer would copy only the expiry check

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity (ZONEMD time-of-check window); supplied diff is CWE-400 algorithmic complexity

O10_build.project_tests: testcode/unitauth.c, testcode/unitzonemd.c and testdata/*.rpl replay tests via testbound (offline)
